purpose: Feasibility/update search for an existing purposive pilot; not a completed systematic search or review.

pubmed.query: ("Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Dysplasia"[MeSH Terms] OR "arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy"[Title/Abstract] OR "arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy"[Title/Abstract] OR "arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy"[Title/Abstract] OR "desmoplakin cardiomyopathy"[Title/Abstract] OR "desmoplakin-related cardiomyopathy"[Title/Abstract] OR "PKP2 cardiomyopathy"[Title/Abstract]) AND (longitudinal[Title/Abstract] OR serial[Title/Abstract] OR progression[Title/Abstract] OR temporal[Title/Abstract] OR "time course"[Title/Abstract] OR spatial[Title/Abstract] OR regional[Title/Abstract] OR electroanatomical[Title/Abstract] OR "single cell"[Title/Abstract] OR "single nucleus"[Title/Abstract] OR proteomic*[Title/Abstract] OR metabol*[Title/Abstract] OR inflamm*[Title/Abstract] OR "hot phase"[Title/Abstract] OR "gene therapy"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1800/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2026/11/03"[Date - Publication])

europe_pmc.query: (TITLE_ABS:"arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy" OR TITLE_ABS:"arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy" OR TITLE_ABS:"arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy" OR TITLE_ABS:"desmoplakin cardiomyopathy" OR TITLE_ABS:"PKP2 cardiomyopathy") AND (TITLE_ABS:longitudinal OR TITLE_ABS:serial OR TITLE_ABS:progression OR TITLE_ABS:temporal OR TITLE_ABS:spatial OR TITLE_ABS:regional OR TITLE_ABS:electroanatomical OR TITLE_ABS:"single cell" OR TITLE_ABS:"single nucleus" OR TITLE_ABS:proteomic* OR TITLE_ABS:metabol* OR TITLE_ABS:inflamm* OR TITLE_ABS:"hot phase" OR TITLE_ABS:"gene therapy") AND FIRST_PDATE:[1800-01-01 TO 2026-11-03]
europe_pmc.scope_note: Europe PMC and PubMed overlap substantially. They are not treated as independent databases or independent confirmation.

planned_additional_sources: Embase or Web of Science/Scopus subject to institutional access
backward and forward citation chasing for included studies
publisher checks for early-online publications and corrections
screening_status: Not started for these search results. Existing 23 studies remain the unchanged pilot corpus.
